notes:
{扉|とびら} specifically refers to a hinged door that swings open, as opposed to sliding doors. It often has a more literary or formal nuance than ドア.

Distinctions:
- {扉|とびら}: hinged door (literary, includes gates)
- ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧: door (casual loanword, common in daily speech)
- ⟦{戸|と}→戸：00676_to⟧: general term for door/sliding door
- ⟦{障子|しょうじ}→障子：04201_shouji⟧: paper sliding door
- ⟦{襖|ふすま}→襖：03908_fusuma⟧: opaque sliding door

Figurative usage:
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{扉|とびら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (open new doors/possibilities)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{扉|とびら} (the door of one's heart)
